compliance_units.constraint: shall apply to CII which are OT systems

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that the OT CII is not connected to any enterprise network except where necessary for operating the CII and provided that the direction of data flows is restricted to only one-way from the OT CII to the enterprise network

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall monitor the data flows from the OT CII to any enterprise network for anomalies and trigger an alert for investigation when any anomaly is detected

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall implement separate authentication mechanisms and account credentials for users of the OT CII network and any enterprise network

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that the OT CII has fail-safes to ensure the safety and reliability of operations in the event of a cybersecurity incident

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall identify physical processes controlled by the OT CII and shall perform baseline establishment, monitoring, and failsafe operations for each process
compliance_units.conditions: to the extent possible

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish a baseline tolerance level for the operation time taken by the physical processes

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.context: physical processes controlled by the OT CII
compliance_units.constraint: shall monitor the duration of physical processes for deviations from the baseline tolerance level

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure the field controller controlling the physical processes operate in a failsafe state when deviations outside of the tolerance level occur and trigger an alert for investigation
compliance_units.conditions: when deviations outside of the tolerance level occur

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that the Safety Instrumented System (SIS) is only connected to authorised field devices

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall periodically assess whether it is possible to replace CII assets (including legacy assets) with more secure versions, and make such replacements where possible to improve the cybersecurity of the CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall verify the integrity of all embedded firmware of OT CII assets before they are used in the CII, and shall periodically verify the integrity of all embedded firmware in the OT CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall verify the integrity of the programme codes in a field controller before use, and shall periodically verify the integrity of all programme codes in field controllers

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall identify and include interlocks in the field controllers' programme codes
compliance_units.conditions: field controllers are intended to have a fail-safe state

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish mechanisms to validate the input values to the field controller to ensure that they are within a valid operational range

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that no unauthorised changes are made to the programme code or input values of a field controller

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall assign a separate and designated register block each for reading, writing, validating writes, calculation, and any other relevant function of the field controller

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall identify programme codes in a field controller that function independently of other programme codes within the field controller, and modularise such programme codes to facilitate the detection of malicious codes

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish mechanisms and processes to reduce and manage cybersecurity risks relating to connections between a field controller and any network or device

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish a separate communication module when connecting the field controller to an external network or device, to prevent unauthorised access to the OT CII through the field controller

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.context: mechanisms and processes to reduce and manage cybersecurity risks relating to connections between a field controller and any network or device
compliance_units.constraint: shall implement authentication processes for data transmission between the field controller and any network or device

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.context: connections between a field controller and any network or device
compliance_units.constraint: shall prevent unauthorised data transmission, including unauthorised write functions, to ensure the safety and reliability of the operations

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall prevent data transmission between the field controller and the network or device when the field controller is in a fault or error state
compliance_units.conditions: except where doing so would adversely affect the safety and reliability of operations

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.context: connections between a field controller and any network or device
compliance_units.constraint: shall enable security features such as password-protection

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that all alerts, errors and warnings from the field controllers are investigated in a timely manner

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish mechanisms to monitor for alert suppression in the field controllers and trigger an alert for investigation when any unauthorised alert suppression is detected

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish baselines for normal day-to-day operational activities of field controllers, including baselines for cycle time, operational uptime, stop state, and memory usage, against which the CIIO is to monitor for deviations and anomalous activities, and trigger an alert for investigation when any deviation or anomaly is detected

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall review the baselines referred to in clause at least once every 12 months
compliance_units.conditions: The first instance of this review is to be completed no later than 12 months from the time the baseline is established

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: should ensure that a computer or computer system used by the organisation is not connected to any wireless Local Area Network (LAN)

compliance_units.subject: audit finding remediation plan

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall implement the audit finding remediation plan and complete all remediation actions within the timeframe(s) specified in the said plan, to the Commissioner's satisfaction, and at the CIIO's own cost, and shall update the Commissioner when each remediation action is completed

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that the roles relevant to ensuring the CII's cybersecurity are set out in writing, and the responsibility for each of these roles is assigned to a person working in or for the CIIO

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall specify the organisational structure for persons involved in managing and ensuring the cybersecurity of the CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that the organisational structure prevents conflicts of interest from arising in relation to decisions relevant to the cybersecurity of the CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that the document specifies what each of these roles is authorised to do and/or approve

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that the document is formally approved by the CIIO personally or by the relevant officers responsible for the management of the CIIO
compliance_units.conditions: {"any": ["where the CIIO consists of one or more natural person", "where the CIIO is not a natural person"]}

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that its board of directors (or equivalent body) includes at least one member that has knowledge and awareness of cybersecurity matters to have oversight of the cybersecurity risks to the CII, and to provide guidance to senior management on how to manage systemic cybersecurity risks

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that its senior management includes at least one member that has knowledge and awareness of cybersecurity matters to manage the cybersecurity risks to the CII and ensure that cybersecurity measures are implemented

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish and implement a cybersecurity risk management framework that provides for promotion of risk culture, roles and responsibilities with governance structure, risk assessment methodology, monitoring and reporting processes, risk appetite and thresholds, and process hazard analysis methodology for OT systems

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish and implement a cybersecurity risk management framework that provides for promotion of a 'risk culture' that enables the organisation and its personnel to have open communications about risk, embrace learning from positive and negative experiences, make informed decisions about addressing risks, and carry out risk management efforts commensurate with defined risk appetites

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish and implement processes for the monitoring, communication and reporting of cybersecurity risks in a timely manner

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish and implement process hazard analysis methodology to reduce or remove the impact on safety due to hazardous events
compliance_units.conditions: CII is an OT system

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall include risk identification, risk analysis, risk evaluation, and risk response steps in the cybersecurity risk assessment methodology

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall include non-digital engineering controls as mitigating controls in a cybersecurity risk assessment
compliance_units.conditions: where applicable

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall maintain and keep updated a risk register that records information of all cybersecurity risks including specified elements such as risk scenarios, identification dates, existing measures, current risk ratings, treatment plans, progress status, residual risk ratings, and risk owners

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that all cybersecurity risks listed in the risk register are reviewed and monitored regularly to ensure that the thresholds or limits for residual risk identified in accordance with clause 3.2.1(e) are not breached

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish and implement policies, standards, guidelines and procedures for managing cybersecurity risks and protecting CII against cybersecurity threats that are aligned with this Code, sector regulatory cybersecurity requirements, and applicable sectoral or national cybersecurity policies, standards, directions and procedures, and published and communicated to all personnel and external parties who act on or have access to a CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.context: managing cybersecurity risks and protecting CII against cybersecurity threats
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure policies, standards, guidelines and procedures are aligned with this Code, sector regulatory cybersecurity requirements, and applicable sectoral or national cybersecurity policies, standards, directions and procedures

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.context: managing cybersecurity risks and protecting CII against cybersecurity threats
compliance_units.constraint: shall publish and communicate policies, standards, guidelines and procedures to all personnel and external parties who act on or have access to a CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall review the policies, standards, guidelines and procedures against the current CII cyber operating environment and cybersecurity threat landscape at least once every 12 months

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that actual practices and implementation are consistent with the policies, standards, guidelines and procedures and shall resolve any differences in a timely manner

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall adopt the Security-by-Design Framework 3 established by CSA to the extent that it applies to the CII's system development lifecycle and shall document how and why parts of the Framework are not applicable where they do not apply to the CII's system development lifecycle

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall adopt the defence-in-depth principle, least privilege principle, and segregation of duties principle in relation to its people, process and technologies to reduce cybersecurity risks

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall adopt the least privilege principle to ensure that accounts and users are granted the least extent of access necessary to perform their required functions

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall adopt, to the extent possible, the defence-by-diversity principle and the zero-trust principle in relation to its people, process and technologies to reduce cybersecurity risks

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.context: in relation to its people, process and technologies to reduce cybersecurity risks to the CII
compliance_units.constraint: shall adopt the zero-trust principle to ensure that each request for access to the CII is authenticated, authorised and validated for security configuration and posture before access is granted
compliance_units.conditions: to the extent possible

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish a change management process to identify, authorise, implement and validate all changes made to the CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall remain responsible and accountable for maintaining oversight of the cybersecurity of the CII and for managing cybersecurity risks to the CII
compliance_units.conditions: even when the CII is wholly or partly implemented on cloud computing systems

compliance_units.constraint: shall inform the Commissioner of any plans to implement the whole or any part of the CII on cloud computing systems

compliance_units.conditions: {"all": ["It has conducted a cybersecurity risk assessment of the risks relating to and arising from the proposed implementation on cloud computing systems and ensured that the risks identified can be adequately addressed", "The completed cybersecurity risk assessment is formally accepted by the CIIO and submitted to the Commissioner for review within 30 days of its completion", "Where it appears to the Commissioner that any part of the cybersecurity risk assessment was not carried out satisfactorily, the CIIO has completed rectification works to the Commissioner's satisfaction at the CIIO's own cost and within the timeframe(s) specified by the Commissioner"]}

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall conduct a cybersecurity risk assessment of the risks relating to and arising from the proposed implementation on cloud computing systems and ensure that the risks identified can be adequately addressed

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure the completed cybersecurity risk assessment is formally accepted by the CIIO and submitted to the Commissioner for review within 30 days of its completion
compliance_units.conditions: when implementing the whole or any part of the CII on cloud computing systems

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.context: implementation of CII on cloud computing systems
compliance_units.constraint: shall complete rectification works to the Commissioner's satisfaction at the CIIO's own cost and within the timeframe(s) specified by the Commissioner
compliance_units.conditions: where it appears to the Commissioner that any part of the cybersecurity risk assessment was not carried out satisfactorily

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that the service provider appoints a person within Singapore authorised to accept service of any notice or legal process relating to the provision of services to the CIIO on the service provider's behalf
compliance_units.conditions: where the CIIO is engaging or has engaged the services of a cloud computing service provider to assist in implementing the whole or any part of the CII on cloud computing systems

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall remain responsible and accountable for the cybersecurity of the CII even if it engages an external party to perform or assist in performing any functions, activities or operations in respect of the CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish processes to maintain oversight over all outsourced functions, activities or operations, in order to minimise cybersecurity exposure arising from such outsourcing

compliance_units.subject: CII
compliance_units.constraint: shall include terms in its agreement(s) with the external party to help ensure the cybersecurity of the CII and to reduce or mitigate the impact of any cybersecurity risks associated with the outsourcing

compliance_units.subject: CII
compliance_units.constraint: shall include terms stipulating the rights of the CIIO to commission an audit of the external party's cybersecurity posture in relation to the outsourced functions, activities or operations; or to require that the external party provide a copy of the audit report should the external party commission its own audit for these purposes

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish processes for validating the external party's compliance with the terms required under clause 3.8.3 and any other terms in the agreement relating to cybersecurity

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that it is able to renegotiate the terms of its agreements with external parties
compliance_units.conditions: in the event of new legal or regulatory requirements

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish mechanisms and processes to identify all CII assets and maintain an inventory of the assets including owner/operator, name/description, critical functions, key cybersecurity personnel, dependencies and connections, physical location, outsourced service providers, cloud services, internet links with DDoS mitigation measures, and network topology diagram

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall include in the inventory a description of the internet links supporting the CII, including information on the distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack mitigation measures in place for these internet links

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall update the inventory whenever there is any change to any CII asset or to the information to be recorded in the inventory
compliance_units.conditions: {"any": ["change to any CII asset", "change to the information to be recorded in the inventory"]}

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that access to the CII and between parts of the CII is restricted to authorised personnel, activities, processes and devices

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall put in place authorisation and authentication controls for any access to the CII and between parts of the CII commensurate with the cybersecurity risk profile of the CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that all vendors' access to the CII are documented and pre-approved, supervised by the CIIO, and performed on-site

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that all vendors' access to the CII are documented and pre-approved

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall implement mechanisms to automatically terminate logon sessions after inactivity for a pre-defined time; if the logon sessions cannot be terminated, the CIIO shall monitor the logon sessions for anomalous activities and trigger an alert for investigation when any anomaly is detected

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish and implement a security patch management process that includes monitoring patch releases, verifying patch integrity, testing patches, prioritising application based on risk, applying patches timely, monitoring progress, applying compensating controls when patches cannot be applied, and rolling back patches when necessary

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall monitor the release of security patches for CII assets

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.context: security patch management process for CII assets
compliance_units.constraint: shall verify the integrity of security patches

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall test security patches in a test environment that is similar to the CII production environment to ensure that the patches do not negatively affect the operations and cybersecurity of the CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall prioritise the application of security patches based on the level of risk posed to the operations of the CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall apply security patches in a timely manner to reduce cybersecurity vulnerabilities

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.context: security patch management process for CII assets
compliance_units.constraint: shall monitor and track the progress of patching

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.context: security patch management process for CII assets
compliance_units.constraint: shall apply compensating controls to mitigate and reduce cybersecurity risks in cases where a security patch cannot be applied
compliance_units.conditions: where a security patch cannot be applied

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall include rolling back the application of security patches where necessary in their security patch management process

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that there is management oversight over the effectiveness of the security patch management processes

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish processes to authorise and track the use of portable computing devices and removable storage media that connect to the CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that all authorised portable computing devices adhere to a security configuration baseline that minimally addresses the security practices listed in clause 5.9.2, and satisfies any other security standards and requirements which the CIIO may have for such devices

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that authorised removable storage media are free of malware prior to connecting to the CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that sensitive information relating to the CII (including production data and system configuration information) that is stored in portable computing devices and removable storage media is secured with strong encryption

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that only applications that are necessary for the operation and cybersecurity of the CII and that have been approved by the CIIO are used in the CII and shall establish and maintain a list of such approved applications

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall review the list of approved applications at least once every 12 months

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall verify the integrity of applications before they are used in the CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall implement multi-tier architecture that separates the application and database tiers and implement security controls at each tier

compliance_units.constraint: shall reference the latest Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) or equivalent application security guidelines when designing, developing and testing applications to minimise application security risks
compliance_units.conditions: CII includes web application systems

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall implement a Web Application Firewall (WAF) to monitor for, detect and block web application threats
compliance_units.conditions: CII includes web application systems that are internet-facing

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that compilers and debuggers are used only where necessary and only on devices authorised for such purposes and shall ensure compilers and debuggers are removed when they are no longer required

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that only authorised accounts can connect to and query databases in a CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall ensure that duties relating to system administration and database administration for the CII are segregated and assigned to different persons

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish policies for securing data at rest

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish policies for restricting access to sensitive data to authorised persons

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall monitor databases for anomalous activities and trigger an alert for investigation when any anomaly is detected

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall monitor for bulk queries that exceed a predetermined threshold of data to be retrieved and trigger an alert for investigation when any such bulk query is detected

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall establish processes to identify and track cybersecurity vulnerabilities of the CII

compliance_units.subject: CIIO
compliance_units.constraint: shall remediate all cybersecurity vulnerabilities in a timely manner, with priority given to vulnerabilities that pose a greater risk to the security or operations of the CII

compliance_units.constraint: shall conduct a vulnerability assessment of the CII
